title: Rav Ada of Sura

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in [Niddah 67b](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.67b.17-18) according to the Bach’s reading, raising an objection to Mar Zutra; the text Hyman uses has Rav Ada without further designation.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli has Mar Zutra prohibit and Rav Chinena of Sura permit the practice. Plain Rav Ada addresses Rav Chinena of Sura. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=217&lang=en) calls the speaker Rav Ada of Sura and likewise gives Chinena as his addressee.
Hyman describes an objection to Mar Zutra and reports the Bach’s reading “Ada of Sura.” The reported Bach reading is independent of the spelling in the linked Bavli.
